retina_dataset_2016: provenance and status
Recorded 13 September 2026 by the EyeQ team (CS691 Capstone).

WHAT THIS IS
The GitHub "retina_dataset" (original repository sjchoi86/retina_dataset, now removed;
surviving forks include yiweichen04/retina_dataset and cvblab/retina_dataset, with
history going back to November 2016). Also redistributed on Kaggle as the "cataract dataset"
(jr2ngb), and listed in glaucoma catalogues as "sjchoi86-HRF" (not related to the HRF
High-Resolution Fundus database).

CONTENTS
601 PNG fundus photos, labelled only by folder name:
  1_normal          300
  2_cataract        100
  2_glaucoma        101
  3_retina_disease  100
Image sizes: 2592x1728 (403), 2464x1632 (158), 1848x1224 (40).

STATUS: USE WITH CAUTION
- No documented origin: no hospital, country, camera, dates or grading method.
- No licence. Reuse permission is not granted explicitly. Confirm with the advisor
  before using it in the paper, and do not redistribute.
- Some photos in 2_cataract look sharp with no visible haze, so the cataract label
  may not match ODIR-5K's grading.
- One disease per photo: a glaucoma eye that also has cataract counts as not cataract.
- No optic disc outlines, so it is excluded from the glaucoma heatmap check.

CHECKS PERFORMED (13 September 2026)
- All 601 photos checked against the 7,000 ODIR-5K training photos: no copies found.
- The 101 glaucoma photos checked against ORIGA, DRISHTI-GS and RFMiD 2.0: no overlap.
- No duplicates within the set. This copy is byte-identical to the downloaded archive.

HOW WE USE IT
External test only, never for training or tuning. Reported in its own results row.
  cataract = 1 for 2_cataract; 0 for 1_normal, 2_glaucoma, 3_retina_disease
  glaucoma = 1 for 2_glaucoma; 0 for 1_normal, 2_cataract, 3_retina_disease
